en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.750 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked
about the verse in which Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, said to Musa (as):
"Remove your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa"

(Surah Taha 20:12).
Imam (as) said: "They were made from the skin of a dead donkey."
